name: Cartesia
description: Delivers ultra-low-latency text-to-speech and speech-to-text through the Sonic model family, with a voice-agent framework and streaming WebSocket API.

skills.name: Speech Synthesis
skills.description: Generates natural speech from text with latency low enough for real-time conversational voice agents.

skills.name: Voice Cloning
skills.description: Creates a reusable custom voice from a short reference sample for consistent agent identity across calls.

skills.name: Speech Recognition
skills.description: Transcribes streaming audio to text, feeding live user speech into an agent loop as it is spoken.
